_help: Kept in line with the characters doc by tools/sync-branches.ps1 (run on every import): each Guardian written up in the doc gets the doc's branch, mentor, rank, role, team, guild, zodiac, location, status and disciples here, so edit the doc rather than this file. Add a Guardian here only if the doc has no write-up for them yet (like Valour). branches: one Element-Branch-Subbranch path per line, in display order. zodiacRoots: the Zodiacs of each element, drawn between the element and their disciples' branches. overrides: from-path => to-path.

info.Civilian Name: Lumina Lee; Lǐ Jiā Xīn (李佳昕)
info.Nickname: Mimi (Family’s and Luna’s Nickname), Mini (Brother’s Nickname)
info.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology: Software Engineering
info.Civilian Occupation: Planned — Software Engineer at LumaSoft (Application Software Engineering — ASE)
info.Transformation Item: Blossom-shaped charm bracelet (with a moon in the middle)
info.Signature Ability: Burning petals, flowering light and protective blossoms (Fire shaped by Earth)
info.Strengths: Unusually high destructive potential from her dual-element Core; flames that can illuminate, shield and protect as well as destroy
info.Weaknesses: Believes she must carry every burden herself
info.Fear: Afraid before every fight, though she always looks composed. Of dancing due to a bad fall as a child.
info.Disciple: Luma Coffea, Luma Fractal, Luma Clover; Luma Aster, Luma Marigold, Luma Lotus, Luma Iris are not officially registered.
info.Relationship: Single; Later develops a relationship with Luma Coffea.
info.Family: Fraternal Twin of Asher; Father is deceased. Has 2 older married siblings, each with 2 kids.
info.Close bonds: Coffea and Fractal (university friends, now disciples)
info.Rivals: Luma Lunar (friendly rival); Luma Crosswind (serious rival)
info.Loves: Animals (Cats especially), Sakura, Chocolate
info.Likes: Dancing (but doesn't dance; she would love to dance again one day)
info.Dislikes: White chocolate, interviews and being in the spotlight, being called a hero, people hiding injuries from her, having nothing to do (she feels restless and guilty when she's not being useful), Loud Noises (especially hair dryers or vacuum cleaners)
info.Hates: Someone stepping in front of her to take an attack for her
info.Hobbies: Interested in archery, cat cafe or feeding stray cats, watching dance videos alone, sakura flower viewing, journaling, practicing acrobatics
info.Core Idea of character: Awakened by Earth and born from Fire, Blossom became the first Guardian whose flames could bloom.

info.Civilian Name: Sylvia Ng; Wú Qiān Zhēn (吴芊蓁)
info.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology: Software Engineering
info.Civilian Occupation: Planned — Software Engineer at LumaSoft (Platform Software Engineering — PSE)
info.Signature Ability: Everlasting Bloom – Flora channels Earth magic into surrounding vegetation, accelerating plant growth and strengthening its vitality. She can create protective formations of flowers, and vines while sustaining damaged plants. Following her evolution, these formations can incorporate controlled warmth and embers.
info.Strengths: Healing, plant manipulation, battlefield control, adaptability, teamwork, creativity, emotional support, and strategic observation.
info.Weaknesses: Her protective instincts can cause her to prioritise others over her own safety. Large-scale plant manipulation and sustained healing consume considerable magical energy. Her carefree behaviour may also lead others to underestimate her seriousness.
info.Fear: Losing someone she could have saved, particularly a disciple or someone under her protection.
info.Disciple: Luma Aster, Luma Marigold, Luma Lotus; Luma Coffea, Luma Fractal, Luma Clover, Luma Iris are not officially registered.
info.Relationship: Single; later develops a romantic relationship with Luma Clover (Asher Lim)
info.Close bonds: Luma Blossom (Lumina), Luma Verdant, members of Wildflowers
info.Loves: Plants, flowers, nature, her friends, and spending time with the people she cares about.
info.Likes: Gardening, decorating shared spaces, friendly teasing, group activities, cute accessories, and celebrating small achievements.
info.Dislikes: Seeing people unnecessarily hurt, excessive restrictions, neglect of living things, and being excluded from important decisions.
info.Hates: Cruelty towards vulnerable people, deliberate harm to innocent lives, and the abuse of Guardian powers.
info.Hobbies: Gardening, collecting unusual plants, flower arranging, experimenting with plant care, and trying creative activities with friends.
info.Catchphrase: “There's always room for something to grow!”
info.Core Idea of character: Born from Earth, reborn through Flame. Luma EmberFlora.

info.Relationship: Single; Later develops a relationship with Luma Clover

guardians.name: Coffea
guardians.mentor: Luma Blossom; Luma Flora is not officially registered.

info.Civilian Name: Joe Tan; Chén Nuǎn Yán (陈暖言)
info.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology: Information Security
info.Civilian Occupation: Planned — Cybersecurity Engineer at LumaSoft (Cybersecurity Engineering — CSE)
info.Passed Tests: Planned — Support (Barrier, Healer, Researcher), Strategist, Shadow
info.Signature Ability: Planned — Guardian's Shelter; a reinforced Earth barrier that protects allies and civilians within a designated area. Unlike ordinary barriers that rely entirely on blocking attacks, his barrier distributes incoming force across its structure, reducing the likelihood of a single concentrated strike breaking through. His inherited Fire allows him to manipulate temperature within a controlled area. Rather than generating traditional flames, he can increase or decrease temperatures, allowing him to regulate the environment around those he protects.
info.Strengths: Defensive magic, barriers, endurance, patience, reliability, observation, leadership, teamwork, emotional awareness, and remaining calm under pressure.
info.Weaknesses: Coffea has a tendency to shoulder responsibility without asking for help. His protective instincts can make him reluctant to retreat, especially when someone important to him remains in danger. struggles to express his own emotional needs, often prioritising the comfort of others over himself.
info.Fear: Being unable to protect someone despite being physically present. He is particularly afraid of surviving an incident in which someone he loves is seriously harmed because he could not reach them in time. Losing Blossom.
info.Mentor: Luma Blossom; Luma Flora is not officially registered.
info.Relationship: Single; later develops a romantic relationship with Luma Blossom (Lumina).
info.Close bonds: Luma Fractal (Felix), Luma Aster (Amelia), Luma Marigold (Aurelia), Luma Blossom (Lumina), Luma EmberFlora (Sylvia)
info.Loves: Spending quality time with people he cares about, peaceful evenings, thoughtful gestures, and seeing his loved ones happy and safe.
info.Likes: Coffee, home-cooked meals, quiet conversations, gentle teasing, comfortable environments, and spending time with close friends.
info.Dislikes: Unnecessary conflict, reckless decisions that endanger others, people refusing help when clearly overwhelmed, and being unable to contribute during emergencies.
info.Hates: Bullying, cruelty towards vulnerable people, betrayal of trust, and deliberately abusing one's authority or strength.
info.Hobbies: Making coffee, cooking, baking, exercising, gaming with friends, and trying new cafés.
info.Catchphrase: "I've got you. Just focus on what's ahead."
info.Core Idea of character: Coffee, loyalty, protection and quiet devotion.

info.Civilian Name: Felix Ang; Hóng Bó Wén (洪博文)
info.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology: Information Security
info.Civilian Occupation: Planned — Cybersecurity Engineer at LumaSoft (Cybersecurity Engineering — CSE)
info.Signature Ability: Planned — Fractal Analysis; perceives structural patterns, stress distribution, weaknesses, and magical energy flow within his surroundings. By examining these relationships, he can identify vulnerabilities, predict structural failures, and determine effective defensive positions. His ability is particularly useful for analysing barriers, buildings, and battlefield conditions.
info.Weapon/Medium: Magical Analysis Tablet; A compact tablet formed from blue-white Earth magic that acts as an external interface for Fractal's analytical abilities. It displays structural maps, Core signatures, magic density, Guardian positions, barrier strength, and magical energy flow. Fractal can select and filter individual layers, reducing the mental strain caused by processing too much information simultaneously. The tablet does not generate his abilities but helps him control and interpret the information his Core perceives.
info.Strengths: Analytical thinking, pattern recognition, structural analysis, observation, adaptability, strategic planning, precise magical control, identifying weaknesses, and predicting potential threats.
info.Weaknesses: Fractal tends to overanalyse situations and can become frustrated when forced to act without sufficient information. His structural perception can overwhelm him with excessive details, resulting in headaches, difficulty concentrating, and mental exhaustion. Although his medium helps regulate this information, prolonged use of his abilities can still strain his Core.
info.Fear: Making a critical miscalculation that results in someone being seriously injured, especially when he believes he should have noticed the danger beforehand.
info.Relationship: Single; later develops a romantic relationship with Luma Marigold (Aurelia).
info.Family: Descendant of Luma Umbra's (Erebus Ang) older brother. Parents, single child in the family.
info.Close bonds: Luma Coffea (Joe), Luma Aster (Amelia), Luma Marigold (Aurelia), Luma Blossom (Lumina), Luma Emberflora (Sylvia)
info.Loves: Solving complicated problems, discovering how things work, and spending time with people who understand his quieter personality.
info.Likes: Technology, logical discussions, puzzles, strategy games, organised information, quiet environments, and observing interesting magical phenomena.
info.Dislikes: Incomplete explanations, vague instructions, unnecessary interruptions, unpredictable situations, and being rushed into decisions.
info.Hates: Deliberate misinformation, manipulation, reckless decisions that endanger others, and people abusing positions of trust.
info.Hobbies: Gaming, programming, solving logic puzzles, reading about technology, experimenting with software, and analysing interesting systems.
info.Core Idea of character: A quiet strategist whose mind moves faster than flame.

guardians.name: Aster
guardians.mentor: Luma Flora; Luma Blossom and Luma Essence (unofficial).

info.Civilian Name: Amelia Chua; Cài Zǐ Xuān (蔡紫瑄)
info.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology: Information Security
info.Civilian Occupation: Planned — Security Analyst; later transitions into Physiotherapy, receiving additional Guardian medical training from Luma Solace, Luma Sage, and Luma Essence.
info.Passed Tests: Planned — Support (Field Healer, Barrier, Researcher), Strategist
info.Signature Ability: Planned — Aster Sanctuary; Aster creates layered, flower-shaped barriers that provide protection and support to allies. Her Earth magic is particularly suited for maintaining stable defensive formations, allowing her to protect injured civilians and create safe spaces for healing. As her abilities develop, she may learn to combine her barriers with healing magic, allowing her to provide treatment while maintaining protection around her patients.
info.Weapon/Medium: Aster Staff; A slender magical staff approximately as tall as Aster, with an aster-shaped focus at its tip that glows with soft violet light.
info.Strengths: Healing potential, barrier magic, patience, compassion, attention to detail, teamwork, perseverance, emotional awareness, and careful decision-making.
info.Weaknesses: Aster lacks confidence in her abilities and sometimes becomes overly cautious, especially when she fears making a mistake. Her tendency to worry can interfere with her concentration, causing instability in her magic. She initially struggles to maintain large barriers without her staff and may exhaust herself by trying to reinforce multiple weakened areas simultaneously.
info.Fear: Failing to save someone who depends on her, particularly through making a mistake during healing or protection.
info.Mentor: Luma Flora; Luma Blossom and Luma Essence (unofficial).
info.Relationship: Single; later develops a romantic relationship with Luma Lotus (Adrian Koh).
info.Family: Twin sister of Aurelia Chua (Luma Marigold). Parents.
info.Close bonds: Luma Marigold (Aurelia), Luma Coffea (Joe), Luma Fractal (Felix), Luma Flora (Sylvia). Luma Blossom (Lumina); later Luma Lotus (Adrian).
info.Loves: Her family, close friends, peaceful environments, and helping people feel safe and comfortable.
info.Likes: Quiet conversations, warm drinks, relaxing activities, reading, gentle encouragement, and spending time with people she trusts.
info.Dislikes: Unnecessary arguments, being rushed into decisions, excessive noise, harsh criticism, and situations where she feels unprepared.
info.Hates: Cruelty towards vulnerable people, intentionally causing suffering, and people exploiting those who cannot defend themselves.
info.Hobbies: Reading, journaling, baking, caring for plants, visiting cafés, and learning about health and rehabilitation.
info.Core Idea of character: Gentle hands, quiet courage, and the strength to protect.

info.Civilian Name: Aurelia Chua; Cài Jīn Yuè (蔡金悦)
info.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology: Information Security
info.Civilian Occupation: Planned — Guardian Merchandise Planner at LumaSoft
info.Signature Ability: Planned — Marigold Burst; Marigold concentrates Earth magic into glowing, flower-shaped formations before releasing them as powerful attacks. Her magic favours rapid movement, concentrated impacts, and explosive bursts of energy rather than sustained defence. As her control improves, she learns to regulate her magical output, allowing her to deliver precise attacks without wasting unnecessary energy or endangering nearby allies.
info.Strengths: High offensive potential, rapid learning, courage, adaptability, quick reactions, determination, teamwork, initiative, and willingness to act under pressure.
info.Weaknesses: Marigold sometimes releases more magical energy than intended, particularly when excited or impatient. Her impulsive nature can cause her to act before fully considering the consequences, while her competitive personality occasionally makes her focus too heavily on immediate results. She initially struggles with defensive techniques because her magic naturally favours outward force.
info.Fear: Being too slow to protect someone important to her, especially Amelia, or accidentally injuring an ally because she failed to control her own power.
info.Relationship: Single; later develops a romantic relationship with Luma Fractal (Felix Ang).
info.Family: Twin sister of Amelia Chua (Luma Aster), Parents
info.Close bonds: Luma Aster (Amelia), Luma Fractal (Felix), Luma Coffea (Joe), Luma Flora (Sylvia), Luma Blossom (Lumina)
info.Loves: Her family, close friends, exciting experiences, celebrating achievements, and making the people around her laugh.
info.Likes: Friendly competitions, teasing her friends, shopping, cute merchandise, trying new activities, and learning new Guardian techniques.
info.Dislikes: Boring routines, excessive restrictions, unnecessary delays, being underestimated, and overly complicated explanations.
info.Hates: Bullying, people deliberately hurting those weaker than themselves, betrayal, and anyone threatening her loved ones.
info.Hobbies: Gaming, shopping, collecting merchandise, dancing, exploring cafés, and planning creative activities with friends.
info.Core Idea of character: A courageous friend who moves the moment an opening appears.

guardians.name: Clover
guardians.mentor: Luma Blossom; Luma EmberFlora is not officially registered.

info.Civilian Name: Asher Lim; Lín Ruì Qí (林瑞祺); Lucas Lee (Biological Name); Lǐ Jié Ruì 李捷瑞 (Chinese Biological Name)
info.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
info.Awakening Type: Self-Awakened (Blossom’s power was introduced during the awakening process)
info.Transformation Item: Clover Wrist Cuff (When deactivated, it's just a silver band)
info.Passed Tests: Planned — Attacker, Support (Barrier, Field Healer, Researcher), Strategist
info.Signature Ability: Planned — Clover's Foundation; Clover reinforces the ground and existing structures using Earth magic, improving their stability and resistance to damage. His ability is particularly useful during evacuations, rescue missions, and situations involving damaged buildings. His knowledge of structural engineering allows him to recognise vulnerable areas and apply magical reinforcement more efficiently.
info.Strengths: Adaptability, observation, problem-solving, structural knowledge, practical judgement, resourcefulness, loyalty, quick thinking, and remaining composed during unfamiliar situations.
info.Weaknesses: Clover can become argumentative when he disagrees with someone's reasoning, especially if he believes their explanation makes little sense. Although observant and cautious, he can be stubborn once he has reached a conclusion. His inherited Fire also introduces additional Core complexity that requires careful monitoring and training.
info.Fear: Losing the family and relationships he has only recently gained, or discovering that his unstable inherited power could endanger them.
info.Mentor: Luma Blossom; Luma EmberFlora is not officially registered.
info.Relationship: Single; later develops a romantic relationship with Luma EmberFlora (Sylvia).
info.Family: Lumina's missing fraternal twin, believed to have died at birth. Both his biological and adoptive fathers are deceased. He has two older biological siblings, both married with two children each.
info.Close bonds: Luma Blossom (Lumina), Luma EmberFlora (Sylvia); members of Wildflowers.
info.Rivals: Friendly sibling rivalry with Luma Blossom.
info.Loves: Feeling included, spending time with loved ones, meaningful acts of affection, and the sense of belonging he gradually develops with his biological family.
info.Likes: Practical problem-solving, clever jokes, quiet company, friendly teasing, exploring interesting places, and learning how things work.
info.Dislikes: Unreasonable instructions, poor explanations, being underestimated, unnecessary restrictions, and people making assumptions about him.
info.Hates: Manipulation, cruelty, betrayal of trust, and people deliberately putting others in danger.
info.Hobbies: Gaming, exploring new cafés, building or designing things, solving puzzles, and trying new activities with friends.
info.Core Idea of character: Lucky.

guardians.name: Lotus
guardians.mentor: Luma Flora; Luma Blossom, Luma Tidal are not officially registered.

info.Civilian Name: Adrian Koh; Xǔ Jùn Háo (许俊豪)
info.Signature Ability: Planned — Lotus Blessing; Lotus specialises in enhancing and protecting allies through Water magic supported by inherited Earth energy. His abilities include creating fast-moving magical currents that increase movement speed, reinforcing allies with flexible defensive layers, and controlling blood loss through precise fluid manipulation and accelerated natural clotting. Rather than focusing on direct combat or complete healing, his magic supports mobility, survival, and emergency stabilisation.
info.Strengths: Speed enhancement, defensive buffs, bleeding control, Water manipulation, emergency stabilisation, battlefield support, adaptability, and teamwork.
info.Weaknesses: Adrian may underestimate danger because of his relaxed attitude. Maintaining buffs on multiple allies consumes significant energy and concentration. His speed enhancements require careful control to prevent loss of balance, while his bleeding control cannot repair major injuries or replace dedicated healing magic.
info.Fear: Discovering that his powers were deliberately given to him for someone else's purposes, especially if using them could unintentionally endanger people he cares about.
info.Mentor: Luma Flora; Luma Blossom, Luma Tidal are not officially registered.
info.Relationship: Single; later develops a romantic relationship with Luma Aster (Amelia Chua).
info.Close bonds: Luma Aster (Amelia); later the other members of Wildflowers. Flower Sisters
info.Loves: Peaceful company, meaningful relationships, quiet moments, and spending time with people who make him feel comfortable.
info.Likes: Relaxed conversations, light teasing, tea, peaceful environments, observing nature, and spending time near water.
info.Dislikes: Unnecessary arguments, excessive drama, being pressured into decisions, and people making situations more complicated than necessary.
info.Hates: Manipulation, exploitation, deliberately harming innocent people, and abusing the trust of others.
info.Hobbies: Reading, swimming, visiting cafés, casual gaming, listening to music, and taking peaceful walks.
info.Core Idea of character: A Guardian awakened through deception who chooses his own path.

guardians.name: Iris
guardians.mentor: Luma Ophiuchus; Luma Blossom and Luma Flora are not officially registered.

info.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science - NTU
info.Civilian Occupation: Software Engineer / Team Supervisor at LumaSoft; Lumina's workplace supervisor.
info.Signature Ability: Planned — Iris Insight
info.Strengths: Software engineering, DevOps, system monitoring, operational analysis, leadership, practical judgement, organisation, investigation, teamwork, attention to detail, problem-solving, and identifying recurring issues.
info.Weaknesses: Iris has limited experience in direct combat and is not naturally inclined towards offensive magic. Her analytical abilities depend on concentration, observation, and access to useful information. She sometimes becomes overly protective of the people under her care and may struggle to delegate when she believes a problem is her responsibility.
info.Fear: Failing to notice a warning sign that could have prevented someone from being injured, particularly a teammate or someone she supervises.
info.Mentor: Luma Ophiuchus; Luma Blossom and Luma Flora are not officially registered.
info.Relationship: Married to Marcus Tan (Luma Chroma). Married at approximately 32–33 years old.
info.Close bonds: Luma Blossom (Lumina), Luma Chroma (Marcus), Luma EmberFlora (Sylvia), members of Wildflowers; Emberbuds community. Supervisors and Colleagues at Lumasoft
info.Loves: Her husband, Blossom, the Emberbuds, supporting her team, seeing others succeed, and knowing that the people she cares about are safe.
info.Likes: Guardian merchandise, organising fan activities, well-maintained systems, efficient workflows, problem-solving, thoughtful designs, and spending time with her husband.
info.Dislikes: Unnecessary overtime, poor communication, avoidable system failures, disorganised work, people neglecting their health, and being kept out of important decisions.
info.Hates: Exploitation, abuse of authority, deliberate manipulation, and anyone recklessly endangering other people.
info.Hobbies: Organising Emberbuds events, collecting Blossom merchandise, working on fan projects, reviewing Marcus's designs, exploring cafés, and occasionally experimenting with personal software projects.
info.Core Idea of character: A Guardian who discovers that protecting others does not always mean standing on the front line.

guardians.name: Chroma
guardians.mentor: Luma Ophiuchus; Luma Prism is not officially registered.

info.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Communication Design - LASALLE
info.Civilian Occupation: Freelance Graphic Designer; Guardian Merchandise Designer at LumaSoft
info.Signature Ability: Spectrum Signal; Produces coloured markers and projections for communication and evacuation
info.Fear: Being unable to protect Mira despite possessing Guardian abilities.
info.Mentor: Luma Ophiuchus; Luma Prism is not officially registered.
info.Relationship: Married to Mira(Luma Iris).
info.Close bonds: Mira Tan (Luma Iris), Luma Ophiuchus; later members of Wildflowers.
info.Rivals: A friendly creative rival from his civilian profession; identity TBD.
info.Loves: creative expression, meaningful design projects, peaceful moments together, and seeing his wife happy.
info.Likes: Graphic design, interesting colour combinations, visual effects, experimenting with layouts, creative challenges, collaborating with others, and supporting Emberbuds activities.
info.Dislikes: Unnecessarily complicated instructions, rushed design approvals, poor communication, creative restrictions without explanation, and having his work repeatedly changed without clear direction.
info.Hates: exploitation of creative work
info.Hobbies: Digital illustration, experimenting with typography and colour palettes, photography, visiting exhibitions, collecting design references, and occasionally creating personal artwork.
info.Core Idea of character: A Guardian who uses creativity to change how others see the world.

info.Civilian Name: Elaine Lu (Singapore Identity); Hoshino Akari 星野明里 (Japan Identity)
info.Nickname: Akari-chan (Leo’s Nickname when Lumen is in civilian form), Aki (Erebus’s Nickname when they are alone), My Light (Erebus’s Romantic Nickname)
info.Languages: Japanese, Chinese, English, French, Malay, Tamil
info.Education: Master of Computing - NTU
info.Civilian Occupation: Senior Executive at LumaSoft, specialising in confidential cybersecurity operations, Guardian identity protection, and Command-linked systems.
info.Signature Ability: - Lumen Aegis; barriers can take numerous forms, including layered shields, large-scale defensive fields, containment structures, protective platforms, and concentrated walls of light. Lumen's barrier techniques are among the strongest known to the Command System, particularly when used to protect large numbers of civilians.
info.Strengths: Exceptional barrier magic, light manipulation, defensive techniques, large-scale civilian protection, strategic judgement, rapid decision-making, leadership, magical control, adaptability, observation, emotional restraint, and centuries of combat experience.
info.Weaknesses: Although exceptionally powerful, Lumen's barriers are not indestructible. Maintaining multiple large-scale defensive structures against sustained attacks consumes significant magical energy. Her strong sense of responsibility also causes her to shoulder burdens privately, making her reluctant to reveal when she is exhausted or emotionally overwhelmed.
info.Fear: Losing someone she loves, particularly Umbra, or leaving him with centuries of grief if she dies before him. She is also deeply afraid of failing to protect those who depend on her.
info.Disciple: Luma Moon, Luma Sun, Luma Star, Luma Mirage, Luma Radiance, Luma Penumbra, Luma Nocturne, Luma Shroud, Luma Chiaroscuro
info.Relationship: Single; has longstanding romantic feelings for Luma Umbra (Erebus), although neither has formally defined their relationship.
info.Family: Deceased; Watching Siblings’ descendents from afar; Luma Chiaroscuro (Future Son)
info.Close bonds: Luma Umbra (Erebus), Luma Moon, Luma Blossom (Lumina), Luma EmberFlora (Sylvia), and her former disciples.
info.Loves: Quiet companionship, the people she has guided, peaceful evenings, and knowing her fellow Guardians have returned safely from their missions.
info.Likes: Quiet environments, thoughtful conversations, well-prepared strategies, observing younger Guardians develop, peaceful routines, and spending time with trusted companions.
info.Dislikes: Unnecessary attention, reckless decisions, avoidable casualties, poor communication, excessive displays of authority, and people refusing to acknowledge their own limits.
info.Hates: Deliberate cruelty, betrayal of trust, exploitation of weaker Guardians, unnecessary sacrifices, and the abuse of Guardian powers.
info.Hobbies: Reading, gardening, quiet walks, enjoying tea, studying historical records, and occasionally observing new Guardian techniques.
info.Catchphrase: "I'll hold the barrier. You protect the others."
info.Core Idea of character: A light that has protected others for centuries, yet still fears the darkness of losing someone she loves.

info.Civilian Name: Erebus Ang; Hóng Yè Chén (洪夜辰)
info.Languages: Chinese, Japanese, English, Malay, Tamil, Chinese dialect(Hokkien, Teochew, Cantonese, Hakka)
info.Education: Master of Computing - NTU
info.Civilian Occupation: Senior Executive at LumaSoft, Cybersecurity and Digital Protection Department.
info.Signature Ability: Shadow Transformation; can merge with existing shadows, travel across connected shadowed surfaces, slip through narrow openings, and remain almost completely invisible to ordinary sight.
info.Strengths: Stealth, infiltration, intelligence gathering, surveillance, tracking, precision combat, situational awareness, strategic planning, investigation, observation, patience, adaptability, efficient decision-making, and remaining calm under pressure.
info.Weaknesses: Umbra's stealth techniques are less effective against opponents who can detect magical signatures independently of sight. Sustained concealment over large areas requires concentration and magical energy. His preference for working independently may also cause him to keep important personal concerns to himself for too long.
info.Fear: Discovering a threat too late to prevent someone important from being harmed, particularly Elaine.
info.Disciple: Luma Penumbra, Luma Nocturne, Luma Shroud (unofficial). All three are officially registered under Luma Lumen's mentorship and lineage, but receive their primary Shadow training from Umbra.
info.Relationship: Single; has loved Luma Lumen (Elaine Lu) for centuries, although neither has formally confessed or defined their relationship.
info.Family: Descendants of his older brother's family remain alive. Luma Fractal (Felix Ang) is one of his distant descendants through that family line. Luma Chiaroscuro (Future Son)
info.Close bonds: Luma Lumen (Elaine), Luma Penumbra, Luma Nocturne, Luma Shroud; later Luma Fractal (Felix).
info.Loves: quiet companionship, knowing those close to him are safe, and the rare moments when he can set aside his responsibilities.
info.Likes: Silence, observation, efficient operations, thoughtful plans, quiet evenings, familiar routines, and spending time with trusted companions.
info.Dislikes: Unnecessary conversation, carelessness, poorly planned operations, drawing attention to himself, avoidable risks, and people revealing confidential information without permission.
info.Hates: Betrayal, exploitation, deliberate cruelty, abuse of authority, and individuals who endanger civilians for personal gain.
info.Hobbies: Reading historical records, strategy games, quiet evening walks, maintaining his equipment, and occasionally investigating obscure mysteries simply out of curiosity.
info.Core Idea of character: A shadow who could disappear from anywhere, yet always chooses to return to the same light.

info.Civilian Name: Serena Moon (Singapore Identity); Tsukino Runa 月野 るな (Japan Identity)
info.Strengths: Powerful ranged magic, precise energy control, adaptability, offensive light manipulation, healing, combat experience, magical endurance, teamwork, mentorship, observation, and rapid decision-making.
info.Weaknesses: Large-scale lunar attacks consume significant magical energy. Performing complex healing while maintaining offensive pressure can strain her concentration. Her strong attachment to loved ones may occasionally influence her judgement when they are threatened.
info.Fear: Losing someone she loves despite centuries of experience and the power to help them.
info.Disciple: Luma Eclipse, Luma Twilight, Luma Perigee, Luma Phase, Luma Gibbous, Luma Lunar; Luma Blossom (unofficial)
info.Stationed at: Japan; formerly spent an extended period in Singapore.
info.Relationship: Married to Luma Sun, Luma Eclipse & Luma Twilight (Daughters)
info.Close bonds: Luma Sun, Luma Eclipse, Luma Lumen, Luma Blossom, Luma EmberFlora, members of Celestials, and her disciples.
info.Loves: Her husband, Her daughter, her disciples, peaceful nights, watching younger Guardians grow, and spending time with people she considers family.
info.Likes: Moonlit scenery, astronomy, celebrations, magical experimentation, teaching, beautiful accessories, and visiting familiar places.
info.Dislikes: Unnecessary conflict, reckless decisions, seeing her disciples discouraged, and people treating less experienced Guardians as expendable.
info.Hates: Cruelty, exploitation, deliberate harm to innocent civilians, and the abuse of Guardian powers.
info.Hobbies: Stargazing, collecting moon-themed ornaments, exploring cafés, reading, teaching new magical techniques, and spending time with her husband.
info.Catchphrase: "Even the darkest night has its light."
info.Core Idea of character: Sailor Moon

info.Relationship: Single
info.Close bonds: Luma Blossom (Lumina)
info.Loves: Rabbits, Moon
info.Hobbies: Star Gazing,

guardians.name: Yew
guardians.mentor: Luma Ophiuchus; Luma Cedar (deceased) and Luma Venom are unofficial mentors.

info.Languages: English, French, Latin, Malay, Chinese, Tamil
info.Original Element: Fire — permanently active to neutralise the poison within his body, leaving him unable to consciously manipulate Fire.
info.Inherited Element: Earth — inherited from Luma Venom; poisonous in nature.
info.Transformation Item: Ring decorated with a dark yew berry
info.Signature Ability: Manipulates poisonous Earth-based vegetation, including toxic roots, vines and thorns. His Fire Core continuously burns away the poison spreading through his own body, allowing him to survive his otherwise dangerous inheritance.
info.Strengths: Exceptional strategic intelligence, extensive knowledge of Guardian power and Star Cores, Shadow techniques, poisonous vegetation manipulation, long-term planning, deception and information manipulation. His experience and administrative access allow him to anticipate Guardian operations and conceal suspicious activity.
info.Weaknesses: His Fire Core is permanently occupied with neutralising the poison produced by his inherited Earth power. Although his Fire Core remains active and functional, it cannot spare enough energy for conscious Fire manipulation. If its activity is suppressed or disrupted, the poison will begin spreading through his body, potentially killing him. Deuteranopia (red-green colour blindness).
info.Fear: Losing the protection of his Fire Core and succumbing to the poison within his body.
info.Mentor: Luma Ophiuchus; Luma Cedar (deceased) and Luma Venom are unofficial mentors.
info.Disciple: Many former disciples, all deceased.
info.Relationship: Single; Never Married
info.Likes: Strategic planning, studying Guardian powers, acquiring knowledge, maintaining control over situations.
info.Dislikes: Unpredictability, restrictions on Guardian power, interference with his research.
info.Hates: The limitations imposed by the existing Guardian system.
info.Core Idea of character: A highly respected Guardian strategist secretly operating as Blightyou. Awakened by Luma Venom, he inherited poisonous Earth powers that would have killed him if not for his original Fire Core continuously burning away the poison. Although Fire sustains his life, he cannot control it. Obsessed with overcoming the limitations of Guardian power, he attempts to acquire all four elements and create a perfect, unrestricted Star Core, regardless of the lives sacrificed.

info.Dislikes: Unnecessary restrictions on harmless experimentation, discouraging curiosity, dismissing unusual abilities as useless, and research being conducted without proper consideration for others.
info.Hates: Using Guardians as experimental subjects without consent, exploiting vulnerable people, forbidden Core manipulation, and deliberately harming disciples.
info.Hobbies: Gardening, studying unusual plants, conducting magical experiments, maintaining research journals, and inventing new applications for Earth magic.
info.Core Idea of character: A mentor who believes every Core deserves the freedom to discover its own potential.

info.Strengths: Water manipulation, mobility, maritime rescue, offensive pressure, adaptability, teamwork, quick reactions, and remaining calm during unexpected situations.

info.Languages: Multiple languages acquired throughout his lifetime; fluent in English
info.Education: Extensive knowledge accumulated through centuries of independent study and experience.
info.Civilian Occupation: Independent consultant and adviser; exact civilian identity and occupation remain confidential.
info.Duty Status: Training / Command Operations / Field Operations (Exceptional Missions)
info.Signature Ability: - Serpent's Veil; manipulates heat, light distortion, and magical concealment to obscure himself or others from detection. Unlike ordinary invisibility, the technique can interfere with magical observation, making it especially useful for protecting hidden Guardians.
info.Strengths: Exceptional magical control, centuries of combat experience, concealment, infiltration, observation, strategic judgement, patience, diplomacy, understanding Guardian behaviour, mentoring unconventional disciples, and recognising potential in individuals overlooked by Command.
info.Weaknesses: His independent position sometimes places him in conflict with Command. He is reluctant to reveal information about those under his protection, even when doing so would improve cooperation. His willingness to offer second chances also leaves him vulnerable to betrayal by those who misuse his trust.
info.Fear: Failing to recognise when someone he has protected or trained is becoming dangerous. He fears that his decisions could allow innocent people to suffer, particularly when someone abuses the freedom he defended.
info.Disciple: Luma Yew, Luma Firewall, Luma Chroma, numerous other disciples across the centuries and branches.
info.Close bonds: Members of Zodiacs, trusted former disciples, and independent Guardians who remain under his protection.
info.Rivals: Guardians and Command officials who disagree with his approach to independence and self-awakening.
info.Loves: Seeing formerly lost or rejected individuals find their own purpose, watching disciples mature into responsible Guardians, peaceful moments away from Command, and witnessing people choose compassion without being ordered to.
info.Likes: Quiet environments, meaningful conversations, observing human behaviour, reading historical records, teaching, strategic discussions, and listening to different perspectives.
info.Dislikes: Excessive bureaucracy, needless restrictions, abuse of authority, unnecessary interference in personal freedom, and judging Guardians solely by their origins or awakening type.
info.Hates: Exploitation of vulnerable individuals, forced obedience, using Guardian powers to terrorise civilians, deliberate cruelty, and abusing the trust of one's disciples.
info.Hobbies: Reading, collecting historical objects, studying ancient magical techniques, observing changes in society, and occasionally visiting former disciples without announcing his arrival.
info.Catchphrase: "Power is a choice. What you do with it is yours."
info.Core Idea of character: The hidden thirteenth Zodiac who believes that possessing power does not automatically obligate someone to become a hero.

info.Education: Extensive knowledge accumulated through centuries of Guardian service, independent study, and practical experience.
info.Signature Ability: - Lionheart: Leo reinforces her physical strength, speed, and durability using concentrated Fire magic. Her close-range attacks carry tremendous force, allowing her to overwhelm heavily armoured enemies.
info.Strengths: Exceptional physical strength, close-range combat, endurance, courage, leadership, combat instincts, discipline, adaptability, and centuries of experience.
info.Weaknesses: Leo's direct combat style can make her less effective against enemies who specialise in keeping their distance. Her pride and confidence occasionally cause her to underestimate opponents or attempt to resolve difficult situations through personal strength.
info.Fear: Losing the disciples she has raised and trained, particularly after becoming emotionally attached to them over the centuries.
info.Disciple: Luma Lumen, Luma Umbra, Luma Valour
info.Close bonds: Luma Lumen, Luma Umbra, Luma Valour, the original Zodiacs
info.Loves: watching younger Guardians grow stronger, peaceful days, traditional Japanese culture, and seeing the people she protects live fulfilling lives.
info.Likes: Martial arts, physical training, direct communication, honesty, friendly competitions, tea, and revisiting places from her past.
info.Dislikes: Cowardice disguised as arrogance, unnecessary bureaucracy, reckless behaviour, dishonesty, and people who refuse to acknowledge their mistakes.
info.Hates: Cruelty towards innocent people, exploitation of the weak, betrayal, and using power to oppress others.
info.Hobbies: Martial arts practice, gardening, travelling, reading historical literature, traditional Japanese arts, and occasionally visiting her former disciples.
info.Core Idea of character: A proud lioness who once stood at the forefront of humanity's defence and later entrusted that responsibility to the Guardians she raised.

info.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Communications
info.Signature Ability: Guiding Light — Beacon generates floating lights capable of marking safe routes, identifying hazards, and guiding civilians through dangerous environments. She can adjust their brightness, colour, and movement to transmit simple signals. Her lights are particularly useful during evacuations, search operations, and situations involving poor visibility.
info.Weapon/Medium: None; channels light magic through her hands.
info.Strengths: Communication, rescue coordination, illumination, teamwork, emotional support, adaptability, leadership, and maintaining civilian morale during emergencies.
info.Weaknesses: Her abilities are less effective against enemies that specifically absorb or suppress light. Producing too many lights simultaneously reduces her concentration and control. She sometimes prioritises comforting others over recognising her own exhaustion.
info.Fear: Being unable to guide someone to safety when they are depending on her.
info.Relationship: Single
info.Close bonds: Luma Mangrove, Luma Skyline, Luma Current
info.Loves: Spending time with friends, helping others, celebrations, and making people smile.
info.Likes: Photography, music, colourful decorations, festivals, and spontaneous outings.
info.Dislikes: Being ignored, unnecessary arguments, gloomy atmospheres, and seeing others upset.
info.Hates: Cruelty, bullying, and deliberately frightening vulnerable people.
info.Hobbies: Photography, singing, social activities, volunteering, and designing small decorations.
info.Core Idea of character: A Guardian who believes that even a small light can guide someone through overwhelming darkness.

info.Civilian Name: Tan Mei Lin; Chen Mei Lin 陈美琳
info.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Science
info.Transformation Item: Leaf-shaped bracelet with a root-patterned charm
info.Signature Ability: Mangrove Sanctuary — Mangrove generates extensive root formations capable of stabilising unstable ground, reinforcing damaged structures, and creating natural protective shelters. Her roots can spread through soil, wrap around structures, and redistribute incoming force. They are especially effective in coastal and wetland environments.
info.Strengths: Defensive magic, terrain stabilisation, environmental awareness, patience, endurance, evacuation planning, teamwork, and maintaining protective formations for extended periods.
info.Weaknesses: Her abilities consume significantly more energy when she cannot access soil or existing vegetation. She sometimes refuses to retreat while civilians remain within her protective area.
info.Fear: Being unable to maintain a protective shelter when people are depending on her.
info.Relationship: Single
info.Close bonds: Luma Skyline, Luma Current, Luma Beacon
info.Loves: Nature, animals, peaceful environments, and spending time with loved ones.
info.Likes: Gardening, herbal tea, nature walks, helping younger Guardians, and quiet conversations.
info.Dislikes: Reckless decisions, unnecessary destruction of natural environments, and being rushed.
info.Hates: Deliberately endangering civilians and exploiting vulnerable people.
info.Hobbies: Gardening, hiking, nature photography, and environmental volunteering.
info.Core Idea of character: A Guardian whose strength lies in creating somewhere safe for others to stand.

info.Disciple: Luma Neoaves, Luma Galloanserae

info.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Nursing
info.Signature Ability: Remedial Essence — Remedy channels Earth magic into living organisms to promote natural recovery and stabilise physical injuries. Her abilities specialise in regulating biological processes, reducing the effects of harmful substances, and supporting the body's natural healing mechanisms. She can also neutralise certain toxins and create temporary healing fields for multiple patients. However, the effectiveness of her treatment depends on the severity of the injuries, the complexity of the substances involved, and her available magical energy.
info.Weapon/Medium: Remedy Staff; a slender ivory staff with a crystal focus that helps her direct and distribute healing energy precisely.
info.Strengths: Healing, medical knowledge, toxin neutralisation, emergency stabilisation, concentration, patience, emotional awareness, teamwork, and remaining composed under pressure.
info.Weaknesses: Healing multiple critically injured individuals simultaneously consumes considerable magical energy. Her abilities cannot immediately restore fatal injuries or replace complex medical treatment. Unfamiliar toxins may require additional analysis before treatment. She sometimes neglects her own wellbeing when others require assistance.
info.Fear: Losing someone she could have saved if she had recognised their condition or acted sooner.
info.Relationship: Single
info.Close bonds: Luma Mangrove, Luma Skyline, Luma Current, Luma Beacon
info.Loves: Her family, helping others, peaceful evenings, and seeing patients recover.
info.Likes: Cooking, reading, meaningful conversations, tea, flowers, and spending time with friends.
info.Dislikes: Recklessness, dishonesty, people ignoring medical advice, and unnecessary arguments.
info.Hates: Deliberately harming vulnerable people, medical exploitation, and abandoning injured civilians.
info.Hobbies: Cooking, reading, gardening, volunteering, and trying new recipes.
info.Core Idea of character: A Guardian who believes that healing is not simply removing injuries, but giving people the opportunity to recover and continue living.

info.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Architecture
info.Signature Ability: Skyline Perspective — Skyline manipulates air currents to move rapidly between elevated structures, maintain aerial positions, and observe large areas from above. By sensing disruptions in surrounding airflow, he can identify movement behind obstacles and detect unusual activity across dense urban environments.
info.Strengths: Aerial reconnaissance, mobility, spatial awareness, urban navigation, observation, tactical positioning, and identifying safe evacuation routes.
info.Weaknesses: His movements become less effective in enclosed environments with limited airflow. Maintaining multiple air currents simultaneously requires considerable concentration. He can become overly focused on surveying the wider environment and miss immediate dangers.
info.Fear: Failing to notice a threat until it is too late to prevent someone from being injured.
info.Relationship: Single
info.Close bonds: Luma Mangrove, Luma Current, Luma Beacon
info.Rivals: A friendly rivalry with Luma Current
info.Loves: City skylines, peaceful evenings, architecture, and exploring unfamiliar places.
info.Likes: Rooftop views, photography, coffee, quiet observation, and intelligent conversations.
info.Dislikes: Crowded spaces, unnecessary noise, poor planning, and people interrupting his concentration.
info.Hates: Reckless actions that unnecessarily place civilians in danger.
info.Hobbies: Architectural photography, urban exploration, sketching, and cycling.
info.Core Idea of character: A Guardian who watches the world from above but learns the importance of staying connected to the people beside him.
